chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked: Why did Allah make His Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, an orphan? He said:
So that no one would have obedience due from him.

key_terms.أَيْتَمَ: made an orphan; caused to be without a father
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker in this report
key_terms.طَاعَةٌ: obedience or authority owed to another
key_terms.نَبِيَّهُ: His Prophet, referring to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah make Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله an orphan?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that Allah made the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله an orphan so that no human being would have authority or a claim of obedience over him. It highlights the Prophet’s unique independence and divinely protected status from the earliest stage of life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4750 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked: "Why did Allah (swt) make His Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) an orphan?"
Imam (as) replied: "So that no one would have authority over him."
